events.text: Richard I is crowned King of England at Westminster.
The Treaty of Paris is signed, ending the American Revolutionary War.
Frederick Douglass escapes from slavery in Maryland.
Malcolm Campbell becomes the first person to drive a car faster than 300 mph.
Britain and France declare war on Germany.
Sweden switches from driving on the left to driving on the right.
NASA's Viking 2 spacecraft lands on Mars.
Pierre Omidyar launches AuctionWeb, the website that becomes eBay.

deaths.text: Oliver Cromwell, Lord Protector of England
